mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite high INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS, where both increase by more than 5% YoY, signals robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in joint growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of UNRATE below 5% and PAYEMS growth above 1% MoM signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in joint labor growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL increase above 2% YoY signals demand-driven inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected monetary response.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite high CPIAUCSL growth.
